title: Juicy Sparkle Mexican Cherry Stir-fry
description: A floral, juicy, crowd-pleaser dish featuring cherry tomatoes, cherries, and a hint of nutmeg for a delicious twist on traditional stir-fries, perfect for vegans and keto dieters.

ingredients.name: 2 cups fresh cherries, pitted and quartered
2 tablespoons coconut aminos or tamari sauce

instructions: Heat half of the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onions and garlic; sauté until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add cherry tomatoes and orange juice to the skillet, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 5 minutes or until most juices are absorbed.
Stir in fresh cherries, nutritional yeast, nutmeg, and salt. Continue to cook for an additional minute.
Deglaze with remaining olive oil by adding lime juice; stir constantly to prevent burning. Cook for another minute.
Remove from heat and serve hot or at room temperature as a side dish or over a bed of quinoa.
